CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2612 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 47b6768c731a0f1e5519592216fb29fe02c8226d. Bus nonce: b73e3cccbf154c33e0de8357408277f4. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 47b6768c731a0f1e5519592216fb29fe02c8226d`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 47b6768c731a0f1e5519592216fb29fe02c8226d` or `Fix review: blocked 47b6768c731a0f1e5519592216fb29fe02c8226d <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: b73e3cccbf154c33e0de8357408277f4`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `47b6768c731a0f1e5519592216fb29fe02c8226d` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2612 47b6768c731a0f1e5519592216fb29fe02c8226d") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2612-b73e3ccc`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
REVIEW, round 1, ADVERSARIAL, of PR #2612 (group R10-SOLVER, Closes #2240, Part of #2250) at head 47b6768c731a0f1e5519592216fb29fe02c8226d. Production group (custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py), fixture group. Read the group's brief, architect_note and carries with jq from `git show origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` (`.groups[] | select(.group=="R10-SOLVER")`), and check that every carried precondition is met. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
1. The fix is architecturally sound: every L-BFGS-B run takes its value from the gradient's batch, with one definition and no duplicated objective logic. Report archscore dS (tools/audit/archscore/) at the merge base and at the head. structure.py passes with no budget raise.
2. The failing test comes first. Revert the fix and check that the test fails, then mutate the fused objective yourself (at least five one-line mutants). Any survivor is a finding.
3. Null control: on a flat-price run the fused objective must be value-neutral. Re-run it yourself and quote the numbers.
4. Golden fixtures: drift is claimed only per claim-files.md (direction declared, claims-for equal to VERSION), never re-recorded. Check the claim files three-dot against the merge base.
5. Re-take every figure in the body at this head. `## Red checks` names every red in the branch history (check-runs API). `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head>` is clean. `carry_audit.py check --body` gives 0 unrouted and 0 bad.
Spare the GitHub API. Time box 60 min.
